subject: planner: optimize NewPlanCacheKey (#65361)
summary: Reviewed the first-parent diff for `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache_utils.go` `NewPlanCacheKey`: moved subquery/param-limit cacheability checks earlier, precomputed the hash buffer capacity, removed the shared buffer pool, and returned the key via `hack.String` (unsafe) to avoid a copy. Key material and ordering are unchanged vs the parent; the unsafe string conversion is backed by a fresh per-call byte slice (no pool reuse/mutation after return), so no correctness/privilege/txn/concurrency Blocker/High issues found. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`; this change remains (no later fix suggesting a defect).
